  • Guides · Grok BotSix takeaways from actually reading the Grok Bot 1.0 docsThe author sums up the Grok Bot 1.0 docs in plain words: each Bot has its own job, memory and dated work log, and telling one Bot your time zone tells all of them; all Bots share one cloud computer with a browser, files and a terminal, so they keep working with the laptop closed; the main Bot can create new Bots; a task done once is saved as a skill and can run on a schedule or on a Slack message, email or GitHub event; every action is checked first, with 20 "ask first" rules, and text inside an email or website never counts as your order; Bots can join Zoom and Meet calls and return notes and action items.
